content: Unlocked by CL-26 (bcf_hdr_id2int replacement). Trivial 7-line C function: calls bcf_hdr_id2int to get tag ID, then scans the unpacked d.fmt array for a matching entry. With our Rust HeaderView.dict_lookup this becomes a HashMap get + linear scan of the fmt array. No C memory management needed.
